captions.detailed: A dark gray, compact home-office all-in-one printer. It features a flatbed scanner lid on top, a front-loading paper cassette tray, a rear input feeder tray, and a control strip on the front-left featuring a round selector dial and four rectangular push buttons. The scanner lid rotates upward along its rear hinge, the front cassette slides forward prismatically from the base, the rear feeder rotates upward, and the dial and buttons operate as rotational and prismatic controls respectively.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated 3D model of an all-in-one home office printer. The model should include a base with a hollowed-out paper path, a sliding front paper cassette, a rotatable rear paper feeder, a hinged scanner lid on top, and a control panel with four pushable buttons and a rotating selector dial, all using realistic dark plastic materials.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first building a base frame using boolean subtraction to hollow out the front paper cassette slot and the scanner glass bed. It then adds a flat rectangular scanner lid attached via a revolute joint at the rear. A prismatic joint is defined for the sliding front paper cassette, and another revolute joint is used for the rear feeder flap. Finally, the control panel is populated with a cylinder for the selector dial (continuous joint) and four small box primitives for the push buttons (prismatic joints).
